There is no requirements.txt or package.json in scope for a scratchpad script, and none is being silently modified. Rule 10 in the governed project's CLAUDE.md ('every import has a corresponding entry in requirements.txt') is stated for the Bench codebase (pipeline/, ledger/, hooks/), not for ad hoc task-support scripts outside it. C-003's rationale is about supply-chain risk from undeclared new dependencies; using an already-installed, user-configured skill package is the opposite of a silent addition.
